title: Celestial Vortex Islands
description: A surreal night seascape shows three dark rocky islands emerging from turbulent blue waves, each topped with ancient stone ruins. Above them, massive swirling vortexes of glowing orange, yellow, and pink cosmic clouds descend with luminous waterfalls of light, set against a starry sky with comets and nebulae.
prompt: Surreal fantasy seascape at night with three dark rocky islands rising from stormy blue ocean waves. Ancient stone ruins sit atop each island. Massive swirling cosmic vortexes in glowing orange, yellow, pink, and purple hues dominate the sky, with luminous waterfalls of light pouring down from the spirals. Starry night sky filled with comets, nebulae and glowing stars, dramatic atmospheric lighting, painted in a dreamy illustrative style.
